label: Search bar
description: A product's SEARCH as the hero beat: a white pill that can grow out of a dot (from:'dot' -- the logo's last dot swells, pales and stretches into the bar: the Cosmos handoff), cycles its placeholder, types a query, carries a chip (a colour swatch for 'search by colour', an image thumbnail for 'visual search'), bursts on submit, and slides up to the top of the frame as results arrive (to_y). Position its box where the bar sits (the bar fills the box width). Steps run on the timeline, the caret too. Example: {"from":"dot","at":0.1,"placeholder":"Try 'scandinavian furniture'","steps":[{"at":1.8,"type":"warm minimal interiors"},{"at":3.4,"submit":true}]}.

from.label: dot (default: grows out of a dot) | fade | none

at.label: When the dot appears / the bar enters (s, default 0.1)

dot_color.label: The starting dot's colour (default near-black -- match the logo)

placeholder.label: Placeholder text, or an array of them to cycle

placeholder_every.label: Seconds per placeholder in a cycle (default 1.2)

steps.label: In order: {at, type:'text'} types a query (append:true adds to it) | {at, clear:true} | {at, chip:{color:'#BC361B'} or {image:url} or null} | {at, submit:true} (a burst) | {at, to_y:0.07, duration?} slides the bar to that height of the frame

height.label: Bar height as a fraction of the frame width (default 0.036; capped by the box)

icons.label: The two small icons at the right (default true)

exit_at.label: When the bar leaves (omit to stay)
